# Demo Notebook Nulling Update

## Summary
Updated `tests.ipynb` to be compatible with multi-sample (3D) `Wavefront` and `WavefrontArray`. Implemented `BracewellPhaseShifter` to handle both array and single-wavefront cases, added `stack_method=np.sum` for plotting, and validated final detection.

## Files Modified
- `tests.ipynb` (cells updated):
  - `#VSC-31aa253b` (visualisation pupil)
  - `#VSC-6531b75b` (propagation intermédiaire)
  - `#VSC-aa6d8613` (visualisation propagation)
  - `#VSC-cd853304` (BracewellPhaseShifter + visualisation post-nulling)
  - `#VSC-af49b842` (visualisation champ focal par canal)
  - `#VSC-241e7f83` (détection finale)

## New/Updated Components
- `BracewellPhaseShifter` in notebook:
  - Applies π phase on second channel when `WavefrontArray` is present.
  - Falls back to right-half phase shift for single `Wavefront`.
  - Handles 3D `(samples, size, size)` slicing via `wf.field[:, :, w//2:]`.

## Tests/Validation
- Executed notebook cells via kernel `Python 3.13.9` in venv.
- Visualisations produced for amplitude, log amplitude, and phase per channel.
- Final detection image computed; minor `RuntimeWarning` from `log10` on near-zero pixels mitigated by `+ 1e-10`.
